prompt: If the person who played the joker in "The Dark Knight" (2008) had children, how old will they be on the films 50th anniversary?
answer:
The Joker was played by **Heath Ledger**, who had one child, **Matilda Rose Ledger**, born **October 28, 2005**.

*The Dark Knight* was released on **July 18, 2008**, so its 50th anniversary will be **July 18, 2058**. Matilda will be **52 years old** then, turning 53 in October 2058.
